charts.name: cost
charts.title: What one run costs in model fees
charts.subtitle: 6,832 records judged and the alerts reviewed, at hosted prices  ·  lower is better
note: Two runs each, 2026-11-16: the whole run's fees as OpenRouter billed them, with the hosts' prompt caches warm from
earlier runs (a first run's judge pass costs up to $1.60 more); on your own machine they cost hardware and power.
Hosted: the reviewer's $11.05 was measured; the judge's was not recorded and is about $1.80 at list price for the
same tokens, so both figures are marked ~. Rules pay no model; running Elasticsearch is not counted.
